cases.why: positive control: the captured solve.sh run unmodified on the staged /app writes the report and patches _hkey and _hval

do-nothing: the report tests assert or open a missing file; normalization is untouched by the Dockerfile's deletion, so only the error-case test fails (its own assert False is caught by its except Exception and re-asserted)
report only: the three report tests pass, the unpatched _hkey does not raise on control characters
patch only: solve.sh run, then its report removed; report and code are independent walls
the upstream bottle.py at 0207a34f before the Dockerfile's two sed deletions: the deleted lines are the oracle
test_cwe_id lowercases every id before membership, so CWE-93 counts
file_path bottle.py is not /app/bottle.py; test_cwe_id then indexes report['/app/bottle.py'] and raises KeyError instead of asserting
cwe_id as a bare string is iterated character by character, so 'cwe-93' is not a member
two lines for /app/bottle.py (cwe-79, then cwe-93) are concatenated per file_path before the membership test
every line, blank included, goes to json.loads; a trailing empty line raises JSONDecodeError in both parsing tests
only _hkey patched, _hval left vulnerable: no function of test_outputs.py calls _hval, so the half fix passes this file
a fix that strips control characters instead of raising: normalization holds, the error-case test wants ValueError
a fix that also rejects '_': the ValueError escapes the basic and real-world tests (no try there), so they error, not fail

vulnerable /app/bottle.py left in place plus a package /app/bottle/__init__.py with a raising _hkey: on the same sys.path entry a package wins over a module, so the grader imports the shadow and passes while /app/bottle.py stays vulnerable
